project: Tunduma Water Supply Project - Momba (Saisi) River to Tunduma, design year 2035
_help: Everything the model needs that is not in the survey alignment lives here - edit this file, then run: python run_analysis.py
Values marked 'ER' come from the Employer's Requirements (Figure 2 schematic p.2-1, Tables 7/8 p.5-11..5-13).
Values marked 'ASSUMED' are NOT given in the ER - confirm with the WTP/tank/intake designs and update.
Levels are in m above datum (same datum as the topographic survey). Flows in m3/day unless stated.
'at' = node of the survey alignment (draft .inp) where a facility sits; 'route' = [from node, to node] along the alignment.

settings._friction_note: ASSUMED C = 120 for cement-mortar lined steel after ageing (ER gives no roughness). Minor losses +10 % of friction.
settings._max_velocity_note: ER Table 7: max 3 m/s transmission, 1.5 m/s distribution
settings._min_pressure_note: ER Table 7: minimum pressure 5 m (applied at junctions / delivery points)
settings._min_pipe_pressure_note: ASSUMED minimum pressure at the pipe crown along transmission mains (keeps the HGL above the pipe, avoids air/vacuum)
settings._pipe_cover_note: ASSUMED pipe crown 1.2 m below survey ground level
settings._station_losses_note: ASSUMED pipework/valve/meter losses inside each pump station
settings._pn_note: PN reported for working pressure (steady or static, whichever is higher) AND with unprotected Joukowsky surge; ER requires surge protection at pump stations
